subject: Third-party Prequalification: Security Evidence & PO Steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbital.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Third-party Prequalification: Security Evidence & PO Steps

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for moving quickly on the pilot opportunity with Orbital Analytics — excited to get the procurement loop closed so we can start the sandbox workload. Procurement at Redwood has a short prequalification before we can issue a PO. To keep things simple, can you confirm and / or provide the following items by end of next week (we can be flexible if you need more time):

- SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF, signed)
- Penetration test summary/attestation letter (latest report stub is fine)
- ISO 27001 certificate or, if not yet certified, an ISO scope letter and remediation plan
- High-level data flow diagram (DFD) showing where customer data is processed/stored (SVG or PNG)
- Insurance certificate (cyber liability)
- Billing information for PO (legal entity name, remit-to address, tax ID, invoice email)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached checklist)

I attached a short prequalification checklist to show the fields Procurement will expect (prequal_checklist.xlsx). Once we have SOC 2 and the pen test letter the procurement team can provision a standard PO; Karthik (cc'd) will own that. A couple of quick clarifications we need from you: do you run customer workloads in a managed cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and is VPC peering or PrivateLink supported? Also let us know if you require a DPA / custom security addendum.

Proposed next steps:
1) You drop the items above into this thread or upload to the Drive link below.
2) Procurement (Karthik) issues PO once SOC 2 + billing are validated.
3) We sign any required DPA/Docs and schedule a short handoff call.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prequal-pack
HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7892

If a 30-minute call helps to walk the checklist, I can set one up tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Attachment: prequal_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@orbital.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Third-party Prequalification: Security Evidence & PO Steps

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear checklist and timeline. Appreciate the concise ask. Short answers below and I've attached what we have ready:

- SOC 2 Type II: attached (soc2_type2_orbital_may2026.pdf).
- Pen test: summary letter attached (pen_test_letter_may2026.pdf); full report is redacted for third-party distribution but we can provide a redacted executive summary if needed.
- ISO 27001: currently in progress, certificate expected Q1 2027; attached is an ISO scope & roadmap note we can share internally if that helps.
- Data flow diagram: attached (orbital_dfd.svg) — shows where PII is tokenized and stored.
- Insurance: our broker will email a certificate of cyber liability to billing@orbital.ai and aditya.rao@redwood.ai tomorrow.
- Billing: Orbital Analytics, Inc. | 128 Market St, Suite 400 | Tax ID: 12-3456789 | Invoices: billing@orbital.ai

We host in Azure (primary) with failover to GCP; we can support VPC peering and PrivateLink-like connectivity on the Azure side. We are happy to sign Redwood's standard DPA and can add customer-specific language if required.

I uploaded the files to your Drive link as well and cc'd our billing alias on this reply for PO intake. If you want to proceed, please have Procurement (Karthik) confirm the PO line items and we'll countersign.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you prefer to walk the DFD.

—
Sarah Lim
Director, Operations & Security
Orbital Analytics
sarah.lim@orbital.ai | +1 617-555-4491

Attachments: soc2_type2_orbital_may2026.pdf (pdf), pen_test_letter_may2026.pdf (pdf), orbital_dfd.svg (image)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Third-party Prequalification: Security Evidence & PO Steps

Hi Sarah — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading to Drive. Karthik, can you confirm the exact PO language we'll use and whether we need a separate SOW for professional services (we expect a small onboarding fee)? Once SOC 2 + billing are verified, Procurement will issue the standard Redwood PO (net 30) to billing@orbital.ai.

Sarah — one quick ask: could you also confirm the name/email of the person who should receive the PO and the legal entity to sign? We'll include the DPA link in the DocuSign envelope and send over next steps once Procurement confirms.

If it helps, I'll schedule a 20-min sync early next week to stitch legal, procurement and your team.

Thanks,
Aditya
